abstract: Due to limited local renewable energy accommodation space, China's large-scale clean energy bases (LCEBs) must export electricity through interprovincial markets, which creates an urgent demand for flexibility resources. However, existing compensation mechanisms mostly adopt fixed parameters and deterministic assumptions and neglect strategic interactions among multiple agents. Accordingly, this paper conducts a tripartite stochastic evolutionary game study among the government, LCEBs, and flexibility resources, considering a cost compensation mechanism. Firstly, a multi-dimensional value accounting system for flexibility resources is established from four dimensions—regulation rate, inertia support, multi-day regulation, and operational reliability—based on which a composite compensation mechanism is designed. Secondly, replicator dynamic and stochastic differential equations are established, and evolutionary stability conditions are derived. Finally, numerical simulations and sensitivity analysis are carried out. The results show that: 1) under deterministic scenarios, the three parties tend to converge to the optimal equilibrium, while random disturbances may alter the convergence characteristics; 2) the higher the unit social benefit, the earlier government compensation intervention occurs, but excessive compensation inhibits operators' investment incentives; 3) when the basic subsidy amount is 2.0, the penalty base is 4–5, and the initial strategy probability is above 0.7, the system achieves the optimal convergence efficiency.

abstract: The oversubscribed H-1B visa lottery shows that firms expect to profit from H-1B hires: we attribute this to imperfect competition in the native labor market and imperfect visa wage rules, both magnified by H-1B workers’ low reservation wages. The wage gap between H-1B workers and comparable natives — at the heart of the exchange between Borjas (2026) and Clemens (2026) — is only a limited guide to these profits, and hence to how visa demand would respond to the new $100,000 fee. For example, profits can exist with no wage gap at all if the native labor market is imperfectly competitive. Moreover, both imperfect competition and imperfect rules may operate through the sorting of H-1B workers into low-wage firms, rather than through wage differentiation within them. If the profit from H-1B hires reflects wage markdowns, a fee may reward those firms that exploit cheap H-1B labor; allocating visas by wage instead prioritizes high-wage applications, and may also protect native workers.
title: Visa design in an imperfectly competitive labor market: Comment on Borjas and Clemens

abstract: We examine the association between the frequency of digital merchant payment use and financial resilience using microdata from the Global Findex 2025 covering 57,335 account holders across 96 economies. Compared with no use, each of the three usage frequencies, occasional, monthly, and weekly, is positively associated with the probability of financial resilience. The association is particularly pronounced among weekly users for the primary measure, while occasional and monthly users do not differ significantly from each other. The results are confirmed by a weighted logit specification and remain positive when using an alternative measure of resilience, although differences across usage frequencies become less pronounced. A binary benchmark comparing any digital in-store merchant payment use with no use also shows a positive association with financial resilience. However, this aggregate measure masks substantial heterogeneity across usage frequencies.
title: Digital Merchant Payment Frequency and Financial Resilience: Global Evidence

abstract: Allocating a supranational carbon budget involves two choices: how to divide it across regulatory systems and how to distribute it across jurisdictions. The EU made both choices when allocating its 2030 carbon budget, yet little is known about the distributional impact of the choices. We examine how member states are affected by the division of the budget between the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) and the Effort Sharing Regulation (ESR), and by the distribution of the ESR portion among member states. Combining theory with numerical general equilibrium modeling, we show that without the EU’s planned second emissions trading system (ETS2), shifting the budget toward the ESR partition lowers aggregate costs and disproportionately benefits lower-income member states. Giving those states more ESR allowances, however, shifts abatement to richer, high-cost states, creating an equity-efficiency trade-off. With ETS2, shifting the budget toward the ESR partition yields only small cost savings and no longer benefits lower-income states, while reallocating ESR allowances from higher- to lower-income states reduces EU-wide costs. The carbon budget allocation within the ESR has in practice been used to make EU climate policy more equitable and acceptable across member states. Our results indicate that, once ETS2 is in place, allocating more ESR allowances to lower-income member states can lower the EU-wide cost of realizing the 2030 budget, meaning equity and cost-effectiveness need not be traded off.
title: Distributional and efficiency impacts of supranational carbon budget allocations

abstract: This paper studies incentives and implementation in multi-period matching markets. A matching is perfectly α -stable if no individual or pairwise deviation benefits all participants under every feasible rematching and every plausible continuation (Kotowski, 2024). We establish three main results. First, unlike in single-period markets, when there are at least two agents on each side and at least two periods no perfectly α -stable revelation mechanism makes truthful reporting a weakly dominant strategy for all agents on either side, and the perfectly α -stable set and the Pareto efficient set can be disjoint. Second, serial dictatorship over partner sequences yields a Pareto efficient, strategy-proof revelation mechanism. Third, with at least three agents, the entire Pareto efficient rule is Nash implementable; whereas with at least two periods, the perfectly α -stable rule is not : the recursive structure of dynamic stability can violate monotonicity even when every agent’s lower contour set at the selected matching weakly expands. These results distinguish the incentive and implementation properties of efficiency and dynamic stability in multi-period matching markets.
title: Nash implementation of dynamic matching rules

abstract: We develop a simple model to explain why a powerful importer country like the United States may provide political support for international collusive agreements concerning certain imported commodities (e.g. coffee). We show that helping producer countries organize and enforce collusion might be an attractive instrument to advance important geopolitical goals; for example, to reduce the chances that the producer countries will align with a rival global power (e.g., the Soviet Union during the Cold War). Moreover, using this practice, the cost of collusion is shared with other importers (including allies). Thus, collusion might be a superior strategy to foreign aid (a priori a more direct and efficient instrument), which is riddled with free riding problems. The model sheds light on why the United States supported (or failed to support) international commodity agreements during and immediately after the Cold War period.
title: Fighting communism supporting collusion

abstract: Factors in popular asset pricing models are unconditionally minimum-variance inefficient: their returns are autocorrelated, yet this predictability is disconnected from volatility. We show that a model with time-varying risk aversion matches this empirical regularity and provides a prescription for constructing time-series efficient factors. These factors earn substantially higher Sharpe ratios than their original counterparts. Our approach complements procedures that address factors’ cross-sectional inefficiencies by hedging unpriced risks. Combining these procedures yields even greater Sharpe ratio improvements. Enhancing existing factors is likely to provide greater benefits than searching for new ones.
title: Time-series efficient factors

abstract: Oil theft from pipelines funds armed criminal groups around the world. In Mexico, cartels first diversified into oil theft following a crackdown on drug trafficking, then diversified again into gas theft after a crackdown on oil theft in 2019. We develop a model of criminal diversification in which sector-specific capital (i.e., technical skills, corrupted officials, territorial networks) is durable and partially transferable to adjacent sectors. When a crackdown raises costs in one sector, previously accumulated capital facilitates entry into others, irreversibly expanding the criminal opportunity set. Consistent with this ratchet mechanism, we show that Mexico’s 2019 crackdown on oil theft was associated with a 1583% increase in gas pipeline thefts (from near-zero at baseline), an 18% increase in cartel presence, and a 19% increase in homicide rates in gas pipeline municipalities, with effects concentrated near oil infrastructure and driven most strongly by oil theft-specialized cartels. After the crackdown, gas theft persisted while oil theft bounced back, indicating durable expansion of cartel capacity. Findings reveal path-dependent criminal adaptation to enforcement that endogenously expands the reach and violence of organized crime.
abstract_zh: 管道盗油为世界各地的武装犯罪集团提供资金。在墨西哥，贩毒集团在毒品贩运遭到打击后首先多元化进入盗油活动，随后在2019年盗油遭到打击后又再次多元化进入盗气活动。我们构建了一个犯罪多元化模型，其中部门特定资本（即技术技能、被腐蚀的官员、地盘网络）具有持久性，并可部分转移至相邻部门。当打击行动提高某一部门的成本时，此前积累的资本有助于进入其他部门，不可逆地扩大犯罪机会集。与这一棘轮机制相一致，我们表明墨西哥2019年对盗油的打击与天然气管道盗窃增加1583%（基线时接近于零）、贩毒集团存在增加18%、以及天然气管道所在市镇凶杀率增加19%相关联，且效应集中在石油基础设施附近，并由盗油专业化贩毒集团驱动最为强烈。打击行动之后，盗气持续存在，而盗油则反弹回升，表明贩毒集团能力实现了持久扩张。研究发现揭示了犯罪对执法行动的路径依赖式适应，这种适应内生性地扩大了有组织犯罪的触达范围和暴力程度。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

title: Explosive diversification: Cartel adaptation to crackdowns in Mexico
title_zh: 爆炸性多元化：墨西哥卡特尔对打击的适应

abstract: As countries accelerate energy transitions, ensuring that decarbonization advances social as well as environmental goals has become a defining global challenge of Energy Justice. Using Chile, a country spanning six climate zones and marked by high socioeconomic inequality, as an empirical laboratory, we assess how twelve national energy transition policies (ETPs) reshape the geography of energy poverty (EP). Across 346 municipalities and eight complementary indices, our modeling shows that full policy implementation would reduce EP by 24.8%, yet benefits remain spatially and socially uneven. Cold, humid southern regions achieve the strongest declines (Cfc −44.4%; Cfb −34.5%), while arid areas improve by only ≈21%. Higher-income households gain disproportionately (−29.1%) compared to low-income ones (−23.5%). Under the full-implementation scenario, the National Energy Policy is associated with the largest modeled reduction (−38.2%), whereas the Atmospheric Decontamination Plan produces a 2.4% increase in measured national EP that reflects a statistical reclassification effect, driven by shifts in the sample-dependent reference values used to classify non-intervened municipalities. Taken together, these results reveal that climate and inequality are jointly associated with the distributional outcomes of energy transitions, highlighting the urgent need for spatial-sensitive and redistributive policy design to achieve truly just global decarbonization.
abstract_zh: 随着各国加速能源转型，确保脱碳在推进环境目标的同时也促进社会目标，已成为能源正义的一项决定性全球挑战。本文以智利作为实证实验室——该国横跨六个气候带且社会经济不平等程度较高——评估十二项国家能源转型政策（ETPs）如何重塑能源贫困（EP）的地理格局。基于346个市镇和八项互补指数，我们的模型显示，政策全面实施将使EP降低24.8%，但收益在空间和社会维度上仍不均衡。寒冷潮湿的南部地区降幅最大（Cfc −44.4%；Cfb −34.5%），而干旱地区仅改善约21%。高收入家庭的获益不成比例地更大（−29.1%），相比之下低收入家庭为（−23.5%）。在全面实施情景下，国家能源政策与最大的模型化降幅相关（−38.2%），而大气净化计划则使测得的全国EP增加2.4%，这反映了一种统计重分类效应，其驱动因素是用于对未干预市镇进行分类的、依赖样本的参考值发生了变化。综合来看，这些结果表明气候与不平等共同与能源转型的分配结果相关，凸显了迫切需要进行空间敏感且具有再分配性的政策设计，以实现真正公正的全球脱碳。
title: Energy transition and energy poverty: Uneven policy outcomes across indicators and climate contexts
title_zh: 能源转型与能源贫困：政策成效在指标与气候背景间的非均衡性

abstract: We empirically investigate the role of prospect theory in the foreign exchange market. A currency-level measure of prospect-theory value, constructed from the historical distribution of exchange rate returns, negatively forecasts future currency excess returns. A long–short strategy based on this measure yields approximately 5% per annum. Predictability is stronger when arbitrage is limited. Bank order flow is positively associated with prospect-theory value, with inter-dealer and proprietary trading primarily driving this relation. Funds trade against prospect-theory value, acting as arbitrageurs. Overall, our findings suggest that investors evaluate currencies based on historical return distributions, consistent with prospect theory.
abstract_zh: 我们实证研究了前景理论在外汇市场中的作用。基于汇率收益的历史分布构建的货币层面前景理论价值指标，对未来货币超额收益具有负向预测能力。基于该指标的多空策略年化收益约为5%。当套利受限时，可预测性更强。银行订单流与前景理论价值正相关，其中交易商间交易和自营交易是驱动这一关系的主要因素。基金则逆前景理论价值进行交易，充当套利者。总体而言，我们的发现表明投资者基于历史收益分布评估货币，这与前景理论相一致。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Prospect Theory and Currency Returns: Empirical Evidence
title_zh: 前景理论与货币收益：经验证据

abstract: Drawing on cognitive psychology and behavioral theories of pattern recognition and heuristic processing, we offer a new perspective on momentum by highlighting how clear price trends shape investor expectations. Trend clarity (TC) materially strengthens momentum returns: the highest trend-clarity quintile earns annualized returns of 12.68%, compared with 6.90% for a conventional momentum strategy. We also show that TC affects momentum trading intensity within Hong and Stein’s (1999) multiperiod return-chasing model. Additional tests indicate that trading on clear trends is a central feature of momentum, distinct from existing explanations and observable across asset classes and global markets.
abstract_zh: 借鉴认知心理学以及模式识别与启发式加工的行为理论，我们为动量提供了一个新视角，强调清晰的价格趋势如何塑造投资者预期。趋势清晰度（TC）显著增强动量收益：趋势清晰度最高五分位组的年化收益率为12.68%，而传统动量策略为6.90%。我们还表明，TC在Hong和Stein（1999）的多期收益追逐模型中影响动量交易强度。进一步检验表明，基于清晰趋势进行交易是动量的核心特征，区别于现有解释，并可在不同资产类别和全球市场中观察到。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Trended Momentum

abstract: This paper examines how survey design influences the measurement of household inflation expectations in an emerging market context. Using original data from three field pilots we designed and implemented in Mexico, we compare elicitation formats that gather point forecasts and subjective probability distributions. We document substantial heterogeneity in the level, dispersion, and uncertainty of reported expectations across sociodemographic groups and survey designs, and show that the relationship between point forecasts and distribution-based measures varies systematically across formats. The study further investigates the sources of cross-sectional heterogeneity by assessing differences in dispersion across formats after accounting for respondent characteristics, examining variation in expectations both across and within individuals, and estimating a structural model to identify potential drivers of measurement error. By documenting the importance of question framing for data quality, this study offers guidance for the design of household surveys and contributes to broader efforts to improve the measurement of expectations across diverse national contexts.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了调查设计如何影响新兴市场背景下家庭通胀预期的测量。利用我们在墨西哥设计并实施的三次实地试点所获得的原始数据，我们比较了收集点预测和主观概率分布的 elicitation 格式。我们记录了不同社会人口群体和调查设计下所报告预期在水平、离散度和不确定性方面存在的显著异质性，并表明点预测与基于分布的测度之间的关系在不同格式间存在系统性差异。本研究进一步通过以下方式考察横截面异质性的来源：在考虑受访者特征后评估不同格式间离散度的差异，考察个体之间和个体内部预期的变异，以及估计结构模型以识别测量误差的潜在驱动因素。通过记录问题框架对数据质量的重要性，本研究为家庭调查的设计提供了指导，并为改善不同国家背景下预期测量的更广泛努力做出了贡献。
title: Survey framing and household inflation expectations: Evidence from an emerging market economy
title_zh: 调查框架与家庭通胀预期：来自新兴市场经济的证据

abstract: Europe’s competitiveness debate has renewed calls to give greater weight to scale, investment, and efficiencies in merger policy. This column presents evidence from mergers reviewed by the European Commission between 1990 and 2024. On average, markups and profits rise following mergers, while citation-weighted patenting falls for both merging firms and their rivals. The responses of rival firms are particularly informative for distinguishing firm-specific rationalisation from a broader weakening of competitive pressure.
abstract_zh: 欧洲的竞争力辩论再次呼吁在并购政策中更加重视规模、投资和效率。本专栏呈现了1990年至2024年间欧盟委员会审查的并购证据。平均而言，并购后加成率和利润上升，而引用加权专利活动对并购双方及其竞争对手均下降。竞争对手的反应尤其有助于区分企业特定合理化与竞争压力的更广泛减弱。
title: Mergers and European competitiveness: Evidence on innovation and market power
title_zh: 并购与欧洲竞争力：创新与市场势力的证据

abstract: Organised crime can impose costs that extend well beyond violence, market distortions, and weakened institutions. This column presents evidence on the long-run health consequences of illegal toxic-waste disposal in Southern Italy. Comparing municipalities similarly close to illegal disposal sites but differentially exposed because of historical wind patterns shows large and persistent effects on the number of cancer deaths in downwind municipalities. Consistent with epidemiological evidence on dioxin exposure, these effects emerge only after long latencies. Effects are particularly pronounced on deaths from all causes among younger age groups.
abstract_zh: 有组织犯罪所施加的代价远不止暴力、市场扭曲和制度弱化。本专栏呈现了意大利南部非法有毒废物处置对健康的长期影响的证据。通过比较与非法处置场距离相近但因历史风向模式而暴露程度不同的市镇，结果显示，下风向市镇的癌症死亡人数受到巨大而持久的影响。这与关于二噁英暴露的流行病学证据一致，这些影响仅在较长潜伏期后才会显现。影响在较年轻年龄组的所有原因死亡中尤为显著。
authors: Davide Cipullo, Massimiliano Onorato, Gianmario Pelleschi
title: The health costs of organised crime
title_zh: 有组织犯罪的健康成本

abstract: This paper examines theoretically and empirically how extreme temperatures affect the energy intensity of manufacturing firms. A conceptual framework outlines the mechanisms linking temperature and energy intensity, which we test by applying a semi-parametric model to firm-level and climatic data from 2007 to 2015. Compared to temperate days (15–20C), each additional day with temperatures below 5C or above 30C increases energy intensity by 0.97% and 0.47%, respectively. Mechanism analysis reveals asymmetric patterns. Cold extremes increase energy intensity primarily through fossil fuel use for heating, while heat extremes operate through output reductions as electricity supply constraints undermine firms’ investments in cooling equipment. The impact is concentrated among private and small firms and varies across sectors. Climate-scenario analysis implies that energy intensity will increase by 6.66–10.96% (2040–2060) and 10.55–23.49% (2090–2100), with output losses of 5.69–20.60% (equivalent to 4.9–17.7% of 2015 industrial value added), highlighting the need for proactive adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论和实证两方面考察极端温度如何影响制造业企业的能源强度。一个概念框架勾勒了温度与能源强度之间的关联机制，我们通过将半参数模型应用于2007年至2015年的企业层面和气候数据对其进行检验。与温和日（15–20℃）相比，气温低于5℃或高于30℃的每一天分别使能源强度增加0.97%和0.47%。机制分析揭示了非对称模式。极端低温主要通过用于供暖的化石燃料使用提高能源强度，而极端高温则通过产出下降发挥作用，因为电力供应约束削弱了企业对冷却设备的投资。这一影响集中于私营企业和小型企业，并因行业而异。气候情景分析表明，能源强度将在（2040–2060年）增加6.66–10.96%，在（2090–2100年）增加10.55–23.49%，产出损失为5.69–20.60%（相当于2015年工业增加值的4.9–17.7%），凸显了采取前瞻性适应政策的必要性。

abstract: We consider the object allocation problem with money. The seller owns multiple units of an object and is solely interested in her revenue from an allocation. Each buyer can receive at most one unit of the object and has preferences over pairs consisting of consumption of the object and payments, which are not necessarily quasi-linear. We study the seller's incentives to increase her revenue by introducing false-name buyers, a practice commonly referred to as shill bidding. An (allocation) rule is shill-proof if the seller cannot increase the revenue by introducing false-name buyers. A rule is a price-based weak priority rule if there is a profile of prices such that buyers who are willing to receive the object at their own prices do so in descending order of price. We establish that a rule is revenue undominated among the class of rules satisfying shill-proofness, strategy-proofness, and non-imposition if and only if it is a price-based weak priority rule. Our result provides justification for the use of posted-price rules—widely adopted by online marketplaces, and internet auctions as ``buy-it-now'' auctions—over auction-type rules in terms of shill-proofness.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个涉及货币的物品分配问题。卖方拥有多单位物品，且仅关心其收益。每位买方最多可获得一单位物品，并且对由物品消费与支付构成的组合可能具有非拟线性偏好。我们研究卖方通过引入虚假身份买方（通常称为托价投标）来增加收益的动机。若卖方永远无法通过引入虚假身份买方来增加其收益，则（分配）规则是防托价投标的。若存在一个挂牌价格组合，使得愿意按自身价格获得一单位物品的买方按价格从高到低顺序获得分配，则该规则为基于价格的弱优先规则。我们证明：在满足防托价投标性、策略防操纵性和个体理性的规则类中，一个规则在收益上不被支配，当且仅当它是基于价格的弱优先规则。这一刻画为挂牌价格规则提供了基础，依据是其对卖方托价投标的稳健性。
title: Shill-proof rules in object allocation problems with money
title_zh: 货币物品分配问题中的防抬价规则

abstract: This paper examines the direct and indirect effects of agricultural technological change on deforestation using the introduction of genetically modified soy in the Brazilian Amazon. Soy production replaced more land and labor-intensive cattle ranching, slowing local deforestation. However, displaced cattle ranching relocated to connected areas, clearing forest elsewhere and offsetting 39 percent of the forest that was spared locally. Displacement is mediated by the road network, which enables labor mobility and continued access to fixed slaughterhouses. On net, the introduction of genetically modified soy preserved approximately 25,600 square kilometers of forest between 2003 and 2010.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Shifting Landscapes: The Impact of Agricultural Innovation on Deforestation

abstract: To test whether the overwhelming finding of zero credit effects from rural land titling in the literature can be attributed to a perception of registries as static document stores and a narrow focus on agricultural land, this paper explores India’s Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas program. This program issued property cards at low cost to rural residential homesteads, the only asset for the 56 percent of rural households owning no agricultural land, in a way that is digitally integrated into national lending infrastructure. Heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences estimates across 42,000 villages in Madhya Pradesh show that property card issuance created sustained land and credit market activity from zero and reached remote communities as effectively as those near bank branches. This reframes an ideologically charged debate into an actionable agenda that views property registries as key digital public infrastructure, one that India’s ongoing digitization and regulatory reforms are well-placed to advance.

abstract: We study how ambient temperature affects worker injury incidence using football data from the Italian Serie A. This setting links high-frequency weather observations to precisely timed and located work episodes and injuries. Identification relies on within-team-season variation in kick-off temperature. We find that a one-degree increase in temperature raises the number of muscular/overuse injuries by 1.9%, while traumatic injuries are unaffected, suggesting that heat acts primarily through internal physiological stress. We detect suggestive evidence of larger temperature effects when effort incentives are stronger and among midfielders, whose role involves substantial physical demands. Exposure to high temperatures in the days preceding a match is associated with lower injury risk, consistent with short-term adaptation. These findings show how precisely measured environmental exposure can help identify occupational injury risks in physically demanding work settings and inform targeted prevention policies.
title: The Heat Penalty: Temperature and Injury Risk in Professional Football

abstract: In machine learning, identifying which variables contribute predictive information can be as important as predictive accuracy. Tabular foundation models have matched or exceeded the predictive performance of tuned gradient boosting trees on many small- and medium-sized tabular datasets. Yet their ability to recover population-level variable importance has received little attention. We design and conduct a Monte Carlo simulation study to compare variable importance recovery across tabular foundation models and established machine learning baselines. Our framework distinguishes multiple population estimands, pairs each one with an aligned model-agnostic importance estimator, and evaluates recovery in terms of ranking, support, and relative magnitude. Our results show that tabular foundation models are generally competitive with established machine-learning baselines in recovering population variable importance, and often more accurate. We thus extend the evidence for their capabilities to a previously underexamined dimension, further strengthening their appeal.
title: Variable Importance Recovery in Tabular Foundation Models: A Simulation Study

abstract: School entry age policies aimed at earlier enrolment may accelerate educational trajectories and labour market entry, but their effectiveness depends on compliance and subsequent school progression. We study a reform that postponed the school entry cut-off date in half of the German federal states, allowing affected children to enter school one year earlier. Using staggered adoption in a difference-in-differences framework with administrative and German Socio-Economic Panel data, we find that the reform reduced average school starting age by less than one month, despite an average cut-off postponement of almost three months. Less than half of directly affected children entered school earlier, reducing their school starting age by 5.5 months. This age advantage largely persists until secondary school entry, with no evidence of adverse effects on academic track attendance, despite a slight increase in grade repetition. A partial reform reversal produced effects of similar magnitude in the opposite direction, supporting a causal interpretation. Overall, limited compliance substantially reduced the reform's effectiveness, while earlier school entry did not compromise subsequent educational opportunities.
title: The Impact of a School Entry Cut-off Reform on School Starting Age and School Progression

abstract: This paper examines the nonlinear relationship between corruption and political instability and highlights the moderating role of democratic governance. Using a dynamic panel threshold approach on data from 58 countries over 1996-2021, we identify a democracy threshold beyond which the destabilizing effect of corruption weakens and may even reverse. In less democratic countries, corruption significantly increases political instability, whereas in more democratic systems its impact is substantially reduced. The results indicate that electoral integrity, judicial independence, and institutional oversight are central to this mechanism. Strengthening democratic institutions therefore appears crucial for limiting the political consequences of corruption and fostering long-term stability.
title: Corruption and Political Instability: A Threshold Analysis of the Moderating Role of Democracy

abstract: This paper examines how a large and persistent income loss affects health over time. We exploit a Dutch welfare reform that reduced annual income by 13 percent on average among low-income retirees with a migration background. Using population-wide administrative data and a difference-in-differences design, we follow individuals for seven years in a setting with limited scope for offsetting labor supply responses. We find no evidence of an increase in medication use for stress-related conditions. In contrast, adverse effects on lifestyle-related conditions emerge gradually, with medication use increasing by 1.8--2.4 percentage points 4.5--7 years after the income loss. We also find suggestive evidence of increased mortality. These findings show that the health effects of persistent income losses may emerge only gradually and therefore remain undetected in short-run studies.
title: The Long-Run Health Effects of a Permanent Income Loss: Evidence from Low-Income Retired Immigrants

abstract: Digital technologies are reshaping labour markets, challenging workers to adapt. This paper examines the employment effects of exposure to digital technologies and whether baseline skill composition influence labour market adjustment to technological change. Combining harmonized subnational employment data for 69 countries with measures of digital technology exposure and skill composition, we first estimate the employment effects using a shift-share instrumental variable approach. We then examine how baseline skill composition--measured by weighting occupation-specific skill requirements extracted from online vacancy data by subnational occupational employment shares--modulates those impacts. Our findings show that areas with higher demand for cognitive skills experience greater positive employment effects from digital exposure. Areas with stronger managerial and communication skills, such as project and process management or writing, also experience more favourable outcomes, whereas areas specialized in advanced technical skills--including ML and AI--experience weaker outcomes. These results underscore the role of skill composition in shaping labour-market responses to digital shocks and informing skill-development initiatives.
title: From Exposure to Resilience: How Skills Mediate the Employment Effects of Emerging Digital Technologies

abstract: This note re-examines two influential studies (Nollenberger et al., 2016; Rodríguez-Planas and Nollenberger, 2018) that apply an epidemiological approach to PISA data and report that greater gender equality in immigrants’ country of origin is associated with better relative performance of second-generation girls. On the same 2003–2012 data, following their methodology, we find no positive, significant association, and the published estimates lie outside our confidence intervals. They are reproduced only on a restricted sample that omits one host country carrying 53% of the sampling weight; the stated ground is that it has fewer than four origin groups; it has six. Including it is not a specification choice but a consequence of the stated criterion. Even on the restricted sample the published results are not robust: with few host countries and concentrated weights, the pooled estimate is driven by two or three of them rather than by a relationship common to all. Finally, no significant association appears on the 2015–2022 or full 2003–2022 pools, which are more favourable settings. These findings do not rule out a role for origin-country culture, but show that this approach, on these data, does not establish one.
title: Country-of-Origin Gender Equality and Gender Gaps in PISA Test Scores: A Re-examination of Nollenberger, Rodríguez-Planas and Sevilla (2016) and Rodríguez-Planas and Nollenberger (2018)

abstract: This paper studies how discretionary intergovernmental transfers can sustain political dependence in decentralized systems. We develop a probabilistic voting model of two-layered clientelism in which the central government allocates workfare across municipalities while choosing whether programs are administered locally by mayors or centrally by state agencies. When mayors control access to jobs, the center can condition future allocations on local electoral performance, turning mayors into vote brokers. Using municipality-level administrative data on Hungary's workfare program and a difference-in-differences design, we show that higher workfare intensity increased support for both the national incumbent party and local mayors—but only when programs were administered by mayors rather than by state-owned enterprises. Municipalities that delivered weaker support in national elections subsequently received fewer positions in mayor-managed programs, and the electoral returns to workfare are larger where mayoral races are more competitive. Together, these findings show how discretionary local control and politically contingent funding can transform decentralization from a mechanism of accountability into one of vertical clientelism.
title: Decentralized but Dependent: Clientelism through Workfare

abstract: Multivariate linear regression and randomization‐based inference are two essential methods in statistics and econometrics. Nevertheless, the problem of producing a randomized test for the value of a single regression coefficient that is exactly valid when errors are exchangeable, and which is asymptotically valid for the best linear predictor, has remained elusive. In this paper, we produce a test that is exactly valid with exchangeable errors and which allows for general covariate designs; covariates may be continuous as well as discrete and may be correlated. The test is asymptotically valid when the errors are not exchangeable, in particular in the presence of conditional heteroskedasticity.
abstract_zh: 多元线性回归与基于随机化的推断是统计学和计量经济学中的两种基本方法。然而，针对单个回归系数的取值，构造一个在误差可交换时精确有效、且对最佳线性预测因子渐近有效的随机化检验，这一问题一直未能解决。本文提出了一种检验方法，该 method 在误差可交换时精确有效，并允许一般的协变量设计；协变量既可以是连续的，也可以是离散的，并且可以相关。当误差不可交换时，特别是在存在条件异方差的情况下，该检验是渐近有效的。
title:
An Exact
                    t
                    ‐Test

abstract: This paper illustrates and addresses weak identification in the correlated random coefficient (CRC) model that Suri (2011) uses to study agricultural technology adoption. Using the publicly available data set, which differs slightly from the version used in Suri (2011), we obtain different point estimates for the paper's main CRC model. To understand why these differences are as large as they are, we recast the CRC model as a more general random coefficient model in which the returns to hybrid adoption are restricted to be linear in comparative advantage. This reveals that the key structural parameter in the CRC model ( ϕ ), which governs the relationship between baseline productivity and the returns to adoption, is prone to a weak‐identification problem. We then propose a procedure to conduct weak‐identification robust inference on ϕ using test inversion. Our weak‐identification robust confidence intervals contain the original Suri (2011) point estimates, which suggests that the difference in results may be attributable to a combination of minor data differences and weak identification.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述并探讨了Suri(2011)用于研究农业技术采纳的相关随机系数(CRC)模型中的弱识别问题。利用公开可获取的数据集(该数据集与Suri(2011)所用版本略有差异)，我们得到了该文主要CRC模型的不同点估计值。为理解这些差异为何如此之大，我们将CRC模型重构为一个更一般的随机系数模型，其中杂交品种采纳的收益被限定为比较优势的线性函数。这揭示出CRC模型中的关键结构参数(ϕ)——它决定了基准生产率与采纳收益之间的关系——容易出现弱识别问题。随后，我们提出了一种利用检验反演对ϕ进行弱识别稳健推断的程序。我们的弱识别稳健置信区间包含了Suri(2011)的原始点估计值，这表明结果的差异可能归因于细微的数据差异与弱识别的共同作用。
title:
Comment on
                    ‘Selection and Comparative Advantage in Technology Adoption’ by Tavneet Suri
title_zh: 评Tavneet Suri《技术采纳中的选择与比较优势》

abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset‐price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors (“discount rates”). We show that a combination of realization‐based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset‐price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so‐called lock‐in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig–Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual‐based capital gains taxes.
abstract_zh: 标准最优资本税理论抽象掉了资产价格的建模，因而无法适用于思考资本利得税与财富税。我们在一个存在资产价格变动的环境中研究最优再分配税收，采纳现代金融的观点，即资产价格的波动不仅源于现金流的变化，也源于其他因素（“贴现率”）。我们表明，基于实现原则的资本利得税与现金流税的组合，无论资产价格波动的来源如何，都能实现最优配置。此外，资本利得税通过针对总净交易而非出售单项资产的利得，避免了对投资组合选择的扭曲（即所谓的锁定效应）。这些结果与经典的Haig–Simons综合所得税概念以及近期关于财富税或基于权责发生制的资本利得税的建议形成鲜明对比。
title: Putting the ‘Finance’ Into ‘Public Finance’: A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
title_zh: 将“金融”融入“公共财政”：资本利得税理论

abstract: I develop a new method for estimating production functions with labor‐augmenting technology and apply it to markup estimation. The method imposes limited parametric restrictions and generalizes prior approaches that rely on the CES production function. I first extend the canonical Olley–Pakes framework assumptions to multidimensional productivity and then develop an identification strategy based on a control variable approach and first‐order conditions. I use this method to estimate output elasticities and markups in manufacturing industries in the US and four developing countries. I find that neglecting labor‐augmenting productivity underestimates capital elasticity, overestimates variable input elasticity, and overestimates markups in all countries.
abstract_zh: 我提出一种新方法，用于估计包含劳动增强型技术的生产函数，并将其应用于加成率估计。该方法施加有限的参数限制，并推广了先前依赖CES生产函数的方法。我首先将经典的Olley–Pakes框架假设扩展到多维生产率，然后基于控制变量方法和一阶条件开发一种识别策略。我使用该方法估计美国和四个发展中国家制造业的产出弹性和加成率。我发现，忽视劳动增强型生产率会低估资本弹性、高估可变投入弹性，并在所有国家高估加成率。
title: Production Function Estimation With Factor‐Augmenting Technology: An Application to Markups
title_zh: 使用要素增强型技术的生产函数估计：在加成率中的应用

abstract: This paper investigates concerns that vertically integrated platforms like Amazon steer demand toward their own offers via algorithmic prominence, potentially harming consumers. On Amazon, for each product, the Buybox prominence algorithm selects one seller to feature, influencing which offers consumers consider. Using novel Amazon sales and Buybox (prominence) data, we estimate a structural model capturing the effects of such algorithmic prominence on consumer choices, seller pricing, and entry. We find that the platform can indeed steer demand as 95% of consumers consider only the Buybox offer. The Buybox is highly price‐elastic (−21), but skews toward Amazon's own offers, which are featured as frequently as observably similar offers priced 5% cheaper. Still, as consumers prefer these offers, this skew does not amount to self‐preferencing in the sense of harming consumers: consumer surplus is roughly maximized at the estimated Amazon Buybox advantage, which balances higher prices against showing consumers their preferred offers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了纵向一体化平台（如亚马逊）通过算法突出展示将需求导向自身报价、可能损害消费者的担忧。在亚马逊上，针对每件商品，Buybox突出展示算法会选择一位卖家进行展示，从而影响消费者考虑哪些报价。利用新颖的亚马逊销售与Buybox（突出展示）数据，我们估计了一个结构模型，以刻画此类算法突出展示对消费者选择、卖家定价和进入的影响。我们发现，平台确实能够引导需求，因为95%的消费者仅考虑Buybox报价。Buybox具有很高的价格弹性（−21），但偏向于亚马逊自身的报价，这些报价被展示的频率与可观测相似但价格低5%的报价相同。尽管如此，由于消费者偏好这些报价，这种偏向并不构成损害消费者意义上的自我优待：消费者剩余在估计的亚马逊Buybox优势处大致实现最大化，该优势在较高价格与向消费者展示其更偏好的报价之间取得平衡。
title: Two‐Sided Markets Shaped by Platform‐Guided Search
title_zh: 平台引导搜索塑造的双边市场
